apps.name: BetterBMS
apps.subtitle: JBD / CyberCase BLE BMS
apps.localizedDescription:
BetterBMS talks to JBD (Xiaoxiang) BLE BMS boards such as CyberCase. Live telemetry, MOSFET control, EEPROM parameters, and pack-tuned limits for 4S6P Molicel P45B.

Sign and install with Feather using your own certificate.

versions.localizedDescription: Discharge MOS ON fix: clears EEPROM switch bit (0x2D bit0) when it blocks re-enable; keeps balance bits.
BetterBMS rename; MOS on/off uses official bit map and final FET check; no alternate-bitmap spam.

appPermissions.bluetooth: Connects to your BMS over Bluetooth Low Energy.

news.title: 1.3.6 — MOS ON fix
news.caption: Discharge MOSFET can turn back on. Update via Feather.
